title: hieracium sonchoides subsp. aracioides
intro: Hieracium sonchoides subsp. aracioides, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) that is native to various regions. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
